test_cartpole_scale_interface: test the cartpole_scale environment interface using EnvironmentTestMixin with reward scale 10 and seed 22
run_interface_test: run the InterfaceTest class to validate cartpole environment with 100 random actions from valid set
create_cartpole_env: create a cartpole environment with scaled rewards using cartpole_scale.load with reward_scale and seed parameters
generate_action_sequence: generate a sequence of 100 random actions from valid actions 0 1 and 2 using numpy RandomState
review_interfacetest_class: review the InterfaceTest class that extends EnvironmentTestMixin and provides make_object_under_test and make_action_sequence methods
